records.title: “A Recurring Pattern”: Civilians Paying the Price in Mali’s Drone Campaign
records.authors: Sebastian Vandermeersch, Conflict and Human Rights Team
records.abstract: This Bellingcat and Jeune Afrique investigation examines reported civilian harm from Malian military drone strikes. It locates strike and aftermath footage using satellite imagery and visible landmarks, compares imagery before and after attacks, and checks official claims against humanitarian reporting and witness accounts. Worked examples in Zouera, Amasrakad and Tinzaouaten expose the reasoning behind the geolocations. The investigation discloses cases where casualty identities or civilian status could not be confirmed and records attempts to obtain a military response.

preflight_records.abstract: In June, Bellingcat ran 500 geolocation tests, comparing LLMs from various companies against each other, as well as Google Lens – a staple tool for finding the location of photos.
